query: I made a lasting power of attorney and now I want to revoke it. I still have capacity. I need the official process and who to tell. England and Wales. Who helps?
title: Revoking a lasting power of attorney: who helps

freeHelp.title: Civil Legal Advice (legal aid gateway)
freeHelp.blurb: Check legal aid eligibility and speak to an adviser for housing, debt, family and other civil matters.

freeHelp.title: Families Need Fathers
freeHelp.blurb: Info advice and support to both parents to help them maintain their relationship with their children

freeHelp.title: Grandparents Legal Centre
freeHelp.blurb: specialists in advising about the steps grandparents need to take to try and resolve certain difficult issues

freeHelp.title: Rights of Women
freeHelp.blurb: Free legal advice for women on family, criminal and immigration law.

freeHelp.title: Working Families
freeHelp.blurb: for parents and carers needing advice on maternity and paternity leave and discrimination. They also provide basic benefits advice

freeHelp.title: Dad's House
freeHelp.blurb: Runs a Pro Bono Family Law Clinic on Wednesdays and Fridays each week led by Simon Bruce (Dawson Cornwall), a well renowned family law solicitor.

freeHelp.title: OurFamilyWizard
freeHelp.blurb: A co-parenting app and website. Parents and other family members can use OurFamilyWizard as a central platform to share their most important family information.

freeHelp.title: Citizens Advice Adviceline (England)
freeHelp.blurb: Free phone advice on consumer, debt, housing, employment and more — routes to local help.
